messages.author: 03290ff051991093
messages.subject: dplyr: Deleting Column
parts:
Is there a recommended way to delete/drop a column in dplyr? 

I could still use something like this in dplyr: 

DF[, "colname"] <- NULL   # for data frame
DT[, colname] := NULL]    # for data.table

But I guess this won't work so well for SQL backends. So I'm wondering whether there is a recommended way for dplyr.
